relations.subject: J. N. Samaddar
relations.evidence: and shortly afterwards, the senior lecturer at St. Columba's College at Hazaribagh.

relations.subject: J. N. Samaddar
relations.evidence: In 1912 he was appointed to a similar post at the Patna Government College where he served to the last of his days.

relations.subject: J. N. Samaddar
